fix: Add the repo-contract scanner suites (internal/profiles, internal/phasecoherence, internal/phasespec — the tests that validate TRACKED config on disk) to release-preflight's gate-suite list, or run the full suite preflight when the release diff touches .evolve/. Wiring proof: a preflight run against a tree with a deliberately-tracked invalid profile stub must FAIL before tagging.
notes: The #394 demote-on-failure net worked (v22.13.0 -> prerelease, v22.12.1 stayed Latest). Fix-first precedent: v22.12.0 assetless -> #393/#394.
summary: v22.13.0: preflight PASSed ('all 2 gate-test suites green') while tracked profile stubs violated TestSmoke_RealProfiles + TestRepoPersonaProfilePairing; the breakage surfaced only in release.yml's full suite AFTER the tag was published, costing an assetless demoted release (2nd occurrence of the class after v22.12.0's e2e timeout).
title: Release preflight runs only 2 gate-test suites — repo-contract tests (profiles/phasecoherence/phasespec catalog scanners) are unverified until the post-tag suite fails
